Visibility timeouts

When a consumer receives a message, the queue hides it from other consumers for the visibility timeout.

If the consumer does not delete the message before the timeout expires, the message becomes visible again & another consumer can receive it.

  • Default timeout: 30 seconds
  • Maximum timeout: 12 hours
receive --queue orders --wait 20
Related: dead-letter queues
